slice: Natural conversation round 37: 'argue that X is better' takes a side playfully, not deflect

before.argue that cats are better than dogs: Alright, let's hear it — why cats win this one?

after.argue that cats are better than dogs: Alright, I'll take that side — here's the case. What's your counter?
after.defend pineapple on pizza: Alright, I'll take that side — here's the case. What's your counter?

mechanism: debate/argument-request detector + steer takes the side playfully instead of deflecting the request back
